_provenance: v3 Ch4.6 Development concept (p32+) + For addition.docx overlay where present. No invented geometry.
concept: Protect the core, grow the corridor, hold the hills

zones.label: Urban Core
zones.description: Dense settlement, commercial and administrative centre. Highest population (notably Ward 3: 9,829). Infrastructure pressure concentrated here.
zones.why: Consolidate existing services, manage density, protect heritage, upgrade infrastructure.
zones.pressure: Infrastructure pressure, built-up expansion, flood/landslide interface at river bench.
zones.proposal: Protect and consolidate — infill, heritage protection, drainage, road blacktopping.

zones.label: Growth Corridor
zones.description: Designated expansion area for managed growth.
zones.why: Flatter terraces near primary road score highest in suitability surface (Ch4.4).
zones.proposal: Planned growth — new settlement, transit circuit, land pooling.

zones.label: Agricultural / Forest Belt
zones.description: Agricultural and forest belt — ~68% tree cover (ESA WorldCover, Ch3). Includes tourism assets and homestay ward 10.
zones.why: Ecological asset, hazard-prone steep slopes, food security.
zones.proposal: Hold — agriculture, forest, eco-tourism, homestay cluster Ward 10.
